header.rfp: RFP 2026-07: Patient online booking and reminder system

compliance_table.requirement: Patients must be able to book online 24/7 from web and mobile, without installing an app.
The system shall send automated SMS and email reminders, with timing configurable per clinic.
Central administration of all 14 clinics, each with its own calendars, staff and hours, is required.
Staff must sign in through single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID over SAML 2.0.
Appointments must sync with our electronic health record, ChartBase EHR.
compliance_table.missing: a prebuilt ChartBase EHR connector; the link needs the one-time API integration setup [P], and no source confirms that ChartBase EHR accepts appointment data through an API

compliance_table.requirement: The system shall take deposits and card payments at the time of booking.
The vendor must sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement.
The vendor shall commit to 99.9% monthly uptime, with service credits when it is missed.
All 14 clinics must be live by 2027-03-01.
The vendor shall provide an export of all appointment records in CSV on request.
A waitlist should automatically offer cancelled slots to waiting patients.
Clinicians should have two-way sync with Google and Outlook calendars.
A report of no-show rate by clinic is preferred.
compliance_table.missing: a no-show rate: the sources give no-show counts by day and a CSV export [O6][L8], and none says the reports show a rate

compliance_table.requirement: Patients should complete digital intake forms before their first visit.
The booking page should meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
Provide an itemised three-year total cost for 14 clinics, separating one-time and recurring costs, on Form B.
Provide three references from healthcare customers with several locations.
compliance_table.missing: a third healthcare reference with several locations; two are on file [U]

executive_summary.text: Harbor Physio Group asked for a system that will "reduce missed appointments", "let patients book outside office hours" and "give the central team one view of every clinic's schedule" [R 2.2]. Example Booking Software meets 11 of the 17 requirements in full and 3 in part, can have all 14 clinics live by 2027-02-14 [O9], and prices the base scope at $63,396 over three years [P].

goal_to_requirements.goal: let patients book outside office hours
give the central team one view of every clinic's schedule

answers.answer: Yes. Patients book from a booking page or a button on your website, in any browser on phone or desktop, at any hour [O1][L1]. No app download is needed [L1].
Yes. Automatic SMS and email reminders go out on a schedule each clinic sets, for example 48 hours and 2 hours before the visit [L2]. Patients confirm or cancel by replying [O2][L2].
Yes. On the Business plan, one admin account manages all 14 clinics, and each clinic keeps its own calendars, staff, hours and services [O3][L3]. Each clinic can have up to 20 staff [O3].
Yes. Staff sign in through SAML 2.0 single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID [O7][L5]. Single sign-on is a paid add-on and is included in our price on Form B [P].

Partly. We have no prebuilt ChartBase EHR connector [O8][L6]. Our REST API and webhooks send new, changed and cancelled appointments to other systems in real time [L6], and Form B prices a one-time API integration setup [P]. [GAP: whether ChartBase EHR accepts appointment data through an API, and whether sync must also run back to the booking system. Owner: ask the buyer under 1.4.]
Yes. The system takes deposits and card payments when the patient books [O4].
Yes. We sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement with Business plan customers [L4][W3].
[GAP: our site states a 99.9% uptime SLA, but no source says whether service credits apply. Owner: customer success or legal.]

Yes. From contract start on 2027-01-04 [R 1.2], our standard rollout takes 6 weeks: 2 weeks of setup, then clinics go live in waves of up to 4 a week [O9]. All 14 clinics would be live by 2027-02-14, ahead of 2027-03-01.
Yes. Admins can export all appointment records to CSV at any time, and we provide a full export within 5 business days on request [L9].
No. Automatic waitlist fill is not available today. It is planned for Q2 2027 and is not a commitment [O10].
Yes. Each clinician's calendar syncs both ways with Google Calendar and Outlook [O5][W4].

Partly. Location reports show bookings, cancellations and no-shows by day for each clinic, and every report exports to CSV [O6][L8]. [GAP: whether the reports show a no-show rate, or only no-show counts. Owner: product.]
[GAP: no source says whether patients can complete digital intake forms before the first visit. Owner: product.]
Yes. Our booking page was tested against WCAG 2.1 AA [L10].

Yes. Form B itemises 14 clinics over 36 months [P]. Recurring: Business plan at $99 per clinic a month and single sign-on at $150 a month, $1,536 a month in all. One-time: onboarding at $400 per clinic and API setup at $2,500, $8,100 in all. Three-year total: $63,396. Our alternate adds priority support for $300 a month, $74,196 over three years [P][R 1.8].

Partly. We can offer 2 healthcare references with several locations: Marrowbrook Physio (6 locations) [W1][U] and Quintmoor Dental Group (4 locations) [W2][U]. [GAP: a third healthcare reference with several locations. Owner: customer success.]

questions.question: Does your ChartBase EHR account accept appointment data through an API, and must appointments sync one way (booking system to ChartBase EHR) or both ways?
What service credit terms do you expect when monthly uptime falls below 99.9%?
Would no-show counts by clinic and day, with a CSV export to work out the rate, meet 4.3, or must the report show the rate itself?
If we can name only two healthcare customers with several locations, will two references meet 5.2, or is a third required?

submission_checklist.rule: Submit one PDF through the Harbor procurement portal by 2026-11-20 17:00 Eastern.
Send questions by email to the procurement office by 2026-11-06. Answers are shared with all bidders.
The response must not exceed 25 pages, excluding Form B.
Each answer in sections 3 and 4 must not exceed 150 words.
Pricing must be given on Form B, signed by an officer of the bidder.
Bidders may submit one alternate pricing proposal in addition to the base price.
